messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v3.14. Change window 2026-03-21 16:00-17:00 UTC. Target: canary (eu-west), group=5. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.14 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/34...
maria: Thanks — can we get the backout/runbook link and who the rollback owner is? Any pin procedure we should prep? :eyes:
kevin: Backout runbook here: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-Runbook-v3.14. I'll take rollback ownership unless someone objects.
kevin: Pin command (ops-runner): `rdeploy pin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.14 --duration 30m` — use hotpin only if sustained latency >200ms for 3m.
sophia: I'll add metric guards: p95 latency alarm @200ms, error-rate >1% for 2m. Opening a Grafana watch: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alert/1234
aj: DB migration note: feature flag `ff/pgm/allow_schema_change` is OFF on canary. If we see migration errors toggle off: `ffctl set ff/pgm/allow_schema_change false` on canary nodes.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner assigned: kevin. Contact @kevin (pager:+1-555-0102). Escalation path: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
maria: Kevin, can you paste a short rollback checklist into this thread? We need the steps in-channel.
kevin: Checklist (short):
1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.13 --cluster canary`
2) `k8s rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy -n redwood`
3) Invalidate local prefix cache: `redis-cli -h cache.canary FLUSHDB`
4) Confirm no DB schema errors in logs (`kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=worker | grep schema`)
5) Notify product & reopen change window if we need another attempt.
maria: Great — pinging @product for release-note edits in case of rollback.
product-bot: Noted. Product notified. They will prepare release note amendments and a user-facing blurb if rollback occurs.
sophia: If we need to temporarily pin stable: `rdeploy pin --cluster stable --image redwood:v3.13 --reason \"temp pin during canary rollback\"` — recommend only if stable traffic looks affected.
kevin: Monitoring p95 and error-rate now. Will trigger rollback if thresholds breached. Starting canary deploy.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/5 OK, 2/5 OK, 3/5 OK, 4/5 degraded (p95=225ms) — holdwave triggered, pausing rollouts. Pause triggered by rule `p95 > 200ms`.
maria: Holdwave acknowledged. Kevin, proceed with rollback plan and pin if needed. :thumbsup:
kevin: Running step 1 (rollback to v3.13) now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by kevin at 2026-03-21T16:09:12Z. Will post status updates here.
kevin: Rollback complete on canary clusters. Verifying logs and health checks.
sophia: Metrics look back to baseline: p95 ~95ms, error-rate <0.2%. Recommending 10m observation before any reattempt.
maria: Thanks everyone. Please add a short postmortem note in the release ticket and schedule a quick retro. I'll update the release notes link once product posts the amendment. End thread.
